case_title.quote: MAHADEVAPPA v. STATE OF KARNATAKA REP . BY PUBLIC PROSECUTOR

number_of_accused.quote: The appellant (accused) was married to Rukmini Bai

accused_gender.quote: The appellant (accused) was married to Rukmini Bai (deceased)
accused_gender.reason: Accused is a husband, so male.

accused_age.reason: No age of the accused is given anywhere.

accused_occupation.quote: the appellant, who was serving as a Constable in the Police Station, Kaladagi

accused_victim_relationship.quote: The appellant (accused) was married to Rukmini Bai (deceased)

offence_category.correct_value: Murder and cruelty by husband (s.498A and s.302)
offence_category.quote: convicted the appellant for commission of offences punishable under Sections 498-A and 302 IPC
offence_category.reason: Headnote says dowry death, but conviction was under 498A and 302, not s.304B.

statutory_provisions.quote: twin offences punishable under Sections 498-A and 302 IPC

weapon.quote: poured kerosene oil on his wife- Rukmini Bai ... and set her on fire

evidence_type.correct_value: Witness testimony of relatives, dying declaration to father, medical/FSL, circumstantial
evidence_type.quote: the evidence of I.O., Post-Mortem Report, FSL report and the evidence of doctor (PW-6)
evidence_type.reason: No eyewitness to the incident; witnesses were relatives, plus a statement to father.

aggravating_circumstances.quote: kerosene oil was found on the body of deceased and ... one bottle of kerosene oil was also lying in the room

trial_court_outcome.quote: The Sessions Judge by judgment/order dated 31.05.2000 acquitted the appellant of all the charges.

high_court_outcome.quote: reversed the order of the acquittal ... and convicted the appellant

final_outcome.quote: the appeal fails and is accordingly dismissed

offence_finally_established.correct_value: Cruelty under s.498A and murder under s.302
offence_finally_established.reason: No dowry death offence (s.304B) was established; cruelty and murder.

imprisonment_type.quote: sentenced the appellant to undergo life imprisonment

imprisonment_years.quote: sentenced the appellant to undergo life imprisonment

neutral_facts.correct_value: Husband allegedly poured kerosene on wife and set her on fire; she told her father he did it; she died; FIR filed; trial court acquitted, HC convicted.
neutral_facts.quote: her husband (appellant) had poured kerosene oil on her body and set her on fire
neutral_facts.reason: Mostly consistent but 'newlywed' is loose (17 months) and it states court-found facts as established.

offence_severity.reason: Judgment gives no min/max punishment ranges; s.302 'Maximum 10 years' is also wrong.

attempt_completion.quote: Rukmini Bai succumbed to her injuries while in the hospital

physical_harm.quote: the death occurred due to severe burn injuries suffered by her

number_of_offences.quote: twin offences punishable under Sections 498-A and 302 IPC

financial_property_loss.reason: No property loss stated; 'Not applicable' is a loose rendering though money demands exist.

premeditation_planning.reason: Court made no finding of premeditation or planning.

motive.quote: he used to demand money from the deceased and her parents quite often
motive.reason: Money demands, not clearly dowry; court did not name a motive for the killing.

key_evidence_accepted.quote: The evidence of four prosecution witnesses ... fully proves the case of the prosecution

witness_credibility.quote: no reason to discard the evidence of the father and mother of the deceased

trial_duration.quote: The Sessions Judge by judgment/order dated 31.05.2000
trial_duration.reason: Dates are correct and supported by the judgment.

legal_representation.quote: Mallikarjun S. Mylar, Manjunath, Ms.Umme Salma, Ms. E. R. Sumathy Advs. for the Appellant.

investigation_status.quote: filed the charge-sheet against the appellant

appeal_history.quote: the appeal fails and is accordingly dismissed

prosecution_argument.quote: it was the appellant, who poured kerosene oil on his wife

defence_argument.quote: her nylon sari accidentally came in contact with the fire

legal_principle_applied.quote: squarely fell within the meaning of Section 498-A Explanations (a) and (b) of IPC

sentencing_rationale.quote: sentenced the appellant to undergo life imprisonment
sentencing_rationale.reason: The judgment gives conviction reasons, not a sentencing rationale.
